title: Send Matt your week
intro: This puts your last two weeks directly in front of Matt — so his eyes are on your situation before it goes further. He reads every brief personally and replies here in the app.
previewNote: This is exactly what Matt will see. Nothing is shared until you tap Send.

situationLine.elevated: The load is real — several signals are up.
situationLine.crisis: Multiple serious signals. You shouldn't carry this alone.

notePlaceholder: Anything you want Matt to know that the numbers don't say (optional)
consent: You're choosing to share this with Matt. He's the only person who sees it, and it never leaves the app.
sentBody: Matt reads every brief personally and replies here in the app — usually within a day. If things can't wait, don't: use Crisis Mode or call or text 988 now.
tooSoonTitle: You sent Matt a brief today
tooSoonBody: Give him a moment to catch up — you can send another one tomorrow. If things have gotten worse right now, use Crisis Mode or message him directly.
errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
crisisNote: In an emergency, don't wait for a reply: call or text 988, or call 911.
